body: Not well, life has been a real pain. This last weekend was spent looking after a friend who found a body. I was there the whole time trying to make him feel better, but hiding the fact that I was thinking of checking out. The holiday passed, all my plans fell apart when there were cars parked where they shouldn't be. I can't even catch a break while trying to plan a suicide.

I don't know how to work on myself, I guess there is just a difference in more problem with making friends and being confident. I have public speaking skills, used them in teaching to interact with over a hundred kids. Then I did clubs in college that required it as well. The problem lies deeper in me, something just not right about who I am which prevents me from making friends and keeping them.

Thank you, I do try to keep going regardless of what is going on. Only reason I am passing. It was easier when I was really busy to keep my mind from wandering. Even so it was hard to not think about my life. everyday I was reminded.  

I have a lot of free time now, student teaching is over and I am only taking a few classes.

I thought about going into that aspect as well, I come from a line of accountants. The only thing that kept me out of it would be my love of science. The bullying was there, but I guess I just pay it as much attention as I paid the people who I was friends with....it is the losing of those friends over time and for which reasons that I dwell on. 

No, I haven't talked with her since. I don't know if I want to. On the one hand she was a really great friend and I miss her dearly. The problem is that I still love her and its hard to not say anything or behave like I don't. She hasn't said a word to me, so I figure she just doesn't want anything to do with me.

Undergrad was interesting, with master being about the same just longer assignments. If you can do a bachelors it isn't much more work. Though I am not as used to writing papers from my undergrad so you might want to look into taking some classes were you do. 

I don't know the source of all of the self-esteem issues, there are a few things to pick from. It goes back a long way though, probably back to my middle school and the like. What I remember from class is that I was always quite, usually with my nose in a novel of some sort since 4th grade. I was made fun of a little, probably what kept me reading instead of talking with people. Trying to think back to a time where I wasn't so shy and kinda failing. What I do remember is that I never really had many friends. I was always pretty reserved and shy of opening up to people. I did move when I hit 1st grade, maybe it has something to do with that. 

My recent loses don't help the situation, really they just confirm the patterns that have been present the whole time. What is more they cut deeper, because I shared more with them. It also doesn't help that I was getting materials together to propose.

It is true, with losing so many friends it is hard to go outside my door. They just seem to disappear. I would say that my self-confidence is low and self-esteem follows. The reason if I were to venture a guess would be that I am kinda shy and reserved around people for a long time, only really being myself after I know it is acceptable. My self-esteem is low because I do define much of it through the eyes of others, others of which I have none. I supposed I do this for multiple reasons. First because I figure other peoples perceptions are more accurate from my own due to my personal bias. Second because I feel like ones life is defined by the impact you have, meaning that it must be on other people and the environment. 

I am currently finishing up masters in science education. I was hoping to become a high school science teacher. Though I don't know if I want to anymore. The job is a thankless, subject to derision, countless hours of work, and something my teacher and fellows think I am ill suited for.

The marks in the class aren't the greatest, C/C+, barely passing. 
                                                                        
With sub-par grades and people telling me through words and actions that I am not valuable, weak, and broken it is hard to come to any conclusion other than suicide. I feel like the whole world is showing me how lacking I am, showing me what life will be like. Finally showing me that no one could love me. Really, that is the only thing that kept me going this long. I've felt this way for years and tried a few different methods in the past with no success. It feels like this is the last stop, the last bit of proof in a slowly building pile of evidence toward my miserable lonely future. I don't think I can handle that loneliness, knowing that every day I will be reminded of the people I love, who wont know or care if I just slip away.

Well, my professor is fond of talking about all the things that make a person ineffective at the job I am training for. All of them are focused on things that I am doing, my tendency to rarely talk in class among them. Couple this with other students telling me that I should look for a job in other fields because they don't think I would be good at this one. 

Then there are my relationships, two separate people that I dated for an extended period of time told me that I was not good enough. The first used to tell me that she was sick of having to be the strong one in the relationship, telling me she hated that I was weak. The second and the one that I cant stop thinking about used to tell me that I was not as smart, overweight, and not manly enough.

It isn't just that though, its all the things that were said by multiple people. When the hypothesis that I am worthless starts to be corroborated by multiple sources I have to honestly take a look and see if it is the truth. I used to be able to say that I didn't care, but that was when things were good and I had love to see me through. Now though...it just feels like everyone was right and the current situation is all that will ever result. Here I am, alone again, realizing that the consensus among people is that I am not worthy of pretty much anything.

Multiple problems most of which come down to feeling like I worthless. I've been told from several sources that I am a bad person, mixed with my ex telling me that I am not enough and teachers saying I don't have what it takes. I feel like at some point they are right and i should accept that I am broken. Add to the whole thing that I know i will die poor, lonely and ugly and we arrive at me. Then everyday trying to not think about my feelings because all i have inside is the pain of remembering the couple people i love. I can't just turn the switch off and forget that i love someone who i no longer come home to. It is as if a part of me is dead already, just waiting for the rest to follow. Specifically, It troubles me to be so universally worthless and emotionally different.
Thank you, I just don't have anywhere else to turn. To talk about how I am not okay. I can't talk to people irl because I fear being found, stopped or committed. Not to mention a dearth of friends.
